message.content:
Who challenged the geocentric model?
Copernicus faced opposition from several quarters.
The Catholic Church was a major critic!
Scholars like Erasmus Reinhold also noted errors in his calculations.
Did the public immediately accept his ideas?
No, resistance persisted for decades.
It is fascinating how slowly scientific paradigms shift.
